overview_description.description:
Vertical SaaS focused on the petcare industry.
Growth.pet helps pet grooming shops to focus on pet care and take all the business routines to the cloud.
Booking, customer management, e-commerce, payments, salaries, tips, stock management, mobile grooming routing, all the workflow is managed by growth.pet
We have an advisor who is one of the top pet grooming professionals in the world, he is a captain of the Ukrain grooming team.

product.name: Online Booking
product.description: Allows customers to book pet grooming appointments through a mobile app and website at any time.

product.name: Customer and Pet Database
product.description: Stores detailed information about customers and their pets to support personalized service and business insights.

product.name: Flexible Settings
product.description: Allows businesses to customize system settings to match their existing workflows, automatically adapting the app and website.

product.name: Mobile Grooming Management
product.description: Manages mobile grooming services including route planning, appointment scheduling, and travel time calculation.

product.name: Boarding Management
product.description: Facilitates management of pet boarding services including online bookings, reservation tracking, and capacity monitoring.

product.name: E-Shop
product.description: Enables pet care businesses to sell pet-related products online through their website and mobile app.
